title: expected.json
description: Documentation of the format. The authoritative checks are in eval/loader.py (validate_expected), which also rejects any scalar field that is neither labelled nor listed under 'unlabelled'.

fields.description: Correct value for each scalar field; null means 'the correct extraction is null'.

transaction_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; YYYY-01-01 when only the year is known

alternates.description: Extra acceptable values per field. Only widens what counts as correct.

transliterations.description: Name fields only: the Latin-letter form of a name whose canonical value is in the document's script. A Latin-letter prediction is scored against this and reported as its own form.

unlabelled.description: Fields nobody verified. They are skipped, not counted wrong.
